svg.text: Steps · Hatua
after step 4 · baada ya hatua 4
finished · tayari
Sort the parts. Each box needs 2 × A, 2 × B, 1 × C and 4 × D. Put aside damaged parts.
Panga vipande. Kila sanduku linahitaji A × 2, B × 2, C × 1 na D × 4. Weka kando vipande
vilivyoharibika.
Sand all faces and edges before gluing (grit 120, then 180). Do not sand the tabs and fingers of
the joints – they would become loose.
Sugua nyuso na kingo zote kwa msasa kabla ya kugundisha (namba 120, kisha 180). Usisugue ndimi na
meno ya viungo – vitalegea.
Dry fit: assemble the whole box without glue. Every tab must go in by hand or with light taps of a
wooden mallet. Then take it apart again.
Jaribio bila gundi: unganisha sanduku zima kwanza bila gundi. Kila ulimi uingie kwa mkono au kwa
kugonga kidogo kwa nyundo ya mbao. Kisha lifungue tena.
Lay one side wall A flat, inside up, with the slots for the bottom at the lower edge. Put a little
glue into its slots and insert the bottom C and the four dividers D. C and A fit only one way
round: the smallest compartment is at the same end.
Laza ubao wa pembeni A mezani, upande wa ndani juu, matundu ya ubao wa chini yakiwa chini. Weka
gundi kidogo kwenye matundu yake, kisha chomeka ubao wa chini C na vitenganishi vinne D. C na A
zinaingiana kwa njia moja tu: chumba kidogo kabisa kiko upande mmoja.
Put glue into the slots of the second side wall A and press it on from above.
Weka gundi kwenye matundu ya ubao wa pembeni A wa pili na uubonyeze juu yake.
Glue on the two end walls B: the fingers interlock, the tab of the bottom goes into the slot. The
end walls have a finger recess at the top.
Gundisha mbao mbili za mwisho B: meno yanaingiana, ulimi wa ubao wa chini unaingia kwenye tundu.
Mbao za mwisho zina mfuko wa kidole juu.
Clamp lightly or tie with a strap. Check the right angles with a square, or measure both diagonals
– they must be equal. Wipe off squeezed-out glue at once with a damp cloth.
Bana kidogo kwa vibano au funga kwa kamba. Kagua pembe kwa pembemraba, au pima milalo yote miwili
– lazima iwe sawa. Futa gundi inayotoka mara moja kwa kitambaa chenye unyevu.
Leave clamped for 1 hour, do not use for 24 hours. Then sand the tab ends flush and round the
edges slightly. Glue sets faster in hot weather – work quickly.
Acha ikiwa imebanwa kwa saa 1, usiitumie kwa saa 24. Kisha sugua ncha za ndimi ziwe sawa na
lainisha kingo kidogo. Gundi hukauka haraka wakati wa joto – fanya kazi haraka.
